places.name: Kapaleeshwarar Temple
places.blurb: Travelers explore this vibrant 7th-century Dravidian-style temple dedicated to Lord Shiva in Mylapore.

places.name: Government Museum Chennai
places.blurb: Art lovers visit to see the world's largest collection of Roman antiquities outside Europe and bronze sculptures.

places.name: Varadharaja Perumal Temple
places.blurb: Pilgrims and art lovers visit to witness the exquisite sculpture work and the famous 100-pillared hall.

places.name: Kamakshi Amman Temple
places.blurb: Devotees frequent this major Shakti Peetha dedicated to the goddess Kamakshi.

places.name: Ekambareswarar Temple
places.blurb: Travelers flock to this sprawling temple complex famous for its towering gateway and sacred mango tree.

places.name: Marina Beach
places.blurb: Visitors enjoy leisurely evening walks along India's longest natural urban beach.

places.name: Fort St. George
places.blurb: History enthusiasts tour the first British fortress in India, which now houses a museum.

places.name: Arjuna's Penance
places.blurb: People come to see this massive, intricately carved open-air rock relief depicting scenes from Hindu mythology.

places.name: Mahabalipuram Shore Temple
places.blurb: Tourists visit the iconic 8th-century structural temples overlooking the Bay of Bengal.

places.name: Pancha Rathas
places.blurb: Visitors marvel at these monolithic rock-cut temples shaped like chariots.

places.name: Vellore Fort
places.blurb: Tourists explore this 16th-century fortress known for its massive granite walls and a historic temple inside.

places.name: Golden Temple Sripuram
places.blurb: Pilgrims visit this spiritual park featuring a magnificent temple covered in pure gold foil.
